passes.cast: Matches the Cast details: very pale, white-silver hair, braid over her RIGHT shoulder (front, right, left views; root over right shoulder in back view), dark coat, pauldrons, red cord sash, dark gloves and boots; hilt above RIGHT shoulder and tip by LEFT calf in front and back; no blade showing; chest strap left shoulder to right hip with steel buckle and waist strap present. Front panel matches the v2 Cast front context. Back-only embroidered hem band is plausible design, not flagged.
